name: proxy-linear
description: Read and update Linear issues through `tclaude proxy linear` when your own sandbox holds no Linear API key — the `tclaude agentd` daemon calls Linear's API on the host with the OPERATOR's key, so you never hold one. Use when you need to read the ticket you were spawned against, check its acceptance criteria or discussion, report progress on it, move it to another workflow state, set its project, milestone, assignee or labels, rewrite its description, attach the pull request you opened, or file a new issue. Gated on the `proxy.linear.read` / `proxy.linear.write` slugs, neither granted by default, and bounded by an operator allow-list of Linear teams, a `linear_team` scope on your own grant, or both.
